pr22.head: 530a333
pr22.title: feat(identity): Lane G NodeId + accessPolicy emitter (1.21.0)

missionPremise: The conformant writer and every Factory stage after it are built against eight Track 2 types the published contract does not export. They run on Factory shims that fail the day the contract carries the type. F-15 publishes those types as additive minors in stage order. Sources: OPS-19 F-15; WDLL _inbox/2026-08-27_f15_contract_types_WDLL.md; request _inbox/2026-08-27_f15_contract_types_request.md; law 19_the_instrument_contract.md and 24 Track 2.
completionPredicate: Eight published npm versions 1.23.0 through 1.30.0, each exporting one type family with a src/conformance fixture and a behavioural test that fails on the forbidden violation; CHANGELOG line and ADR-028 amendment per release; consumer compile/test evidence per release; close at _inbox/2026-08-27_f15-contract-types_close.json. npm view is the record.
scopeBasis: hauska-atom-contract only, plus pin-bump test branches on consumers. No Factory/engine/LDT/MCP product code. No accessPolicy column migration (F-10). No language-neutral spec. PR #22 is read, not continued. seat/substrate worktree is not written.

published122.finding: 1.22.0 tarball dist/index.d.ts has zero of NodeId, ProvenanceClass, Derivation, AbsenceVerdict, SupersessionEdge, AliasAtom, SelectorPredicate, AccessPair. No ./identity export map entry. Instrument: npm pack + tar of dist/index.d.ts; Select-String those names returned no matches. Alternative mechanism rejected: '1.21.0 already shipped NodeId because PR #22 targeted 1.21.0' — live 1.21.0 and 1.22.0 are property-family unknown-enum minors (well-fact, rail-corridor), not identity.
published122.whatShipped: 1.21.0 WellStatus/WellType unknown (7e282e6). 1.22.0 RailCorridorStatus/RailCorridorClass unknown (a3984e1). accessPolicy five-value union and access-policy.types.test.ts already on main. temporal/node-id.ts is ADR-011 derive* helpers (evt_, well_), not branded NodeId.
published122.whatDidNotShip: All eight Track 2 named exports. Lane G NodeId. accessPolicy CHECK emitter (scripts/emit-access-policy-check.mjs) — not an F-15 type; left on PR #22.

pr22.finding: PR #22 implements branded NodeId (nid_ + 32 hex, mint/parse, NodeIdParseError, bindNodeIdForWrite) and an accessPolicy CHECK emitter. Version claim 1.21.0 is already consumed by a different publish. Never merged. Five dirty files remain on seat/substrate. Salvage NodeId grammar and constructors only; do not merge, rebase, or write that worktree.

perTypeTable.shimShape: brand nid_ + 32 lowercase hex; mint(); parse() refuses empty and non-matching including 48209:156346; isNodeId; NodeIdParseError code malformed_node_id
perTypeTable.shimRightOrWrong: right. Matches 19 (minted opaque id) and PR #22. Distinct from temporal/node-id.ts derive helpers; no export-name collision.
perTypeTable.releaseDoes: Salvage PR #22 NodeId onto ./identity and root. parse('48021:34137') refuses as NodeId. County-prop grammar is an alias key only (predicate in 1.23.0; AliasAtom in 1.24.0). Type-level test: string literal is not NodeId.

perTypeTable.shimShape: entityType identity.alias; aliasKey; nodeId via refuseSourceKeyAsNode; authority, validFrom, knowledgeAt required; validTo nullable. Lineage not on the shim node.
perTypeTable.shimRightOrWrong: right on the atom and era. Lineage edges (mergedInto, dividedInto, unmerged) are named by 24/WDLL and absent from the shim; contract adds them as edge types, not node fields.
perTypeTable.releaseDoes: AliasAtom + parse refuses missing era. LineageEdge kinds. Type-level: a node type with mergedInto does not compile.

perTypeTable.shimShape: Record | Derivation | Assertion | Absence. Record requires sourceId and forbids derivesFrom. Derivation requires derivesFrom. Assertion requires asserter. Absence routes to verdict fields.
perTypeTable.shimRightOrWrong: right on the four Factory classes. Incomplete vs 19, which names Record | Observation | Derivation | Synthesis (Attention and Judgment reserved, no layer). WDLL mis-cites 19 as Record/Derivation/Assertion/Absence. Contract ships the shim four plus Observation and Synthesis. Reserved classes stay non-constructible.
perTypeTable.releaseDoes: Discriminated union with per-class required fields. parse refuses a class missing its field. Fixtures per class.

perTypeTable.shimShape: derivesFrom requires selectorAtomId, storeVersion, method. Record with derivesFrom refuses.
perTypeTable.shimRightOrWrong: right. Matches 19 materialised-row id = (selector atom id, store-state version, method).
perTypeTable.releaseDoes: Named Derivation export. parseDerivation refuses missing derivesFrom. parseProvenance refuses Record+derivesFrom.

perTypeTable.shimShape: absent-verified: sourceResponded===true and sourceId. lookup-failed: failureRef. not-applicable: excludingRule. Else unknown.
perTypeTable.shimRightOrWrong: right on the three verdicts. WDLL requires source id plus response reference for absent-verified; shim has sourceId + sourceResponded boolean and no responseRef. Contract requires sourceId + responseRef (and sourceResponded true). Stricter than the shim; named so the Factory lane updates the shim delete, not the type.
perTypeTable.releaseDoes: Closed verdict union. Bare string does not compile. Three refusal tests.

perTypeTable.shimShape: { link_type: SUPERSEDED_BY, from, to }. assertNoSupersededByColumn. No closedAt.
perTypeTable.shimRightOrWrong: incomplete. WDLL and 19 require SUPERSEDED_BY as an edge with closedAt on the prior window. Shim omits closedAt. Contract is right; adds closedAt and refuses without it.
perTypeTable.releaseDoes: SupersessionEdge with closedAt. Type-level: atom type with supersededBy field does not compile.

perTypeTable.shimShape: kinds spatial-contains, set-member, eq, range, and, or with per-kind required fields.
perTypeTable.shimRightOrWrong: right. and/or are composition. Flood selectors in the Factory are eq on fld_zone for A, AE, AO, X (conformant.mjs and _inbox/2026-08-27_f16-f18-conformant_close.json item8Flood).
perTypeTable.releaseDoes: Closed union + exhaustive match. Unknown kind does not compile. Flood fixture type-checks four zones.

perTypeTable.shimShape: discoverability and entitlement required, never defaulted. Bare accessPolicy string refuses.
perTypeTable.shimRightOrWrong: right. Matches 19 two-field access. Existing AccessPolicy five-value union stays exported and mapped until F-10 migrates the column.
perTypeTable.releaseDoes: AccessPair. parse refuses one field without the other. mapAccessPolicy keeps AccessPolicy. access-policy.types.test.ts stays green.
